question: Who was the Minister of Finance when the economic reforms of 1991 took place in India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Dr. __****__Manmohan Singh.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manmohan Singh:- **

 
 
• Manmohan Singh, an Indian politician, economist, and statesman was the nation's 13th prime minister from 2004 to 2014. 
 
• He was born on September 26, 1932. After Jawaharlal Nehru and Indira Gandhi, he served as prime minister for the third-longest period of time.
 
• Singh, an Indian National Congress member, served as India's first Sikh prime minister.
 
• He was also the first prime minister to win reelection following a full five-year tenure since Jawaharlal Nehru.
 
• **​**Former Prime Minister Dr. Manmohan Singh was the Union Finance Minister of India during the New Economic Policy 1991.
 
• The main objective of the policy was to plunge the Indian economy into the area of Globalization, to achieve economic stabilization, and also to move towards a higher economic growth rate.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Pranab Mukherjee:-**

 
 
• He was the President of India between 2012 and 2017.
 
• Mr. Mukherjee was the leader of the Indian National Congress.
 
• He was also Union Finance Minister between 2009 and 2012.
 
• He was Finance Minister for the first time in 1982-84. 
 
• Awarded with the highest civilian honor by the government of India in 2019, the Bharat Ratna by President Ram Nath Kovind.
 
• He was also nominated as the leader of Rajya sabha in 1980.
